## Non-duplication and validation

- [ ] I did not add private research, real supplier exports, tokens or secrets to this public repository.
- [ ] This PR does not claim a static demo or an unreviewed AI proposal is a verified business fact.
- [ ] **Shared interface / multi-lane / deployment change:** both owners reviewed or a documented review is explicitly requested. (Check only when applicable.)

## Contract / safety impact
- Input/output schema changed? If yes, specify version, fixture, consumer, reviewer and migration path.
- Cloudflare deployment / D1 / hosts / secrets changed? If yes, STOP and request a separate controller release review.
- Does this change create or duplicate a scraper, manufacturing inference rule engine, supplier matcher or taxonomy?
